part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `parseFunctionBody` (packages/babel-parser/src/parser/expression.js:2378): the expression scope entered there was only exited in the block-body branch, so a concise arrow body (`()=>null`) leaked an expression scope. That unbalanced stack made `parseFunctionParams`'s `exit()` pop the wrong scope, leaving the enclosing `kParameterDeclaration` scope active — so a later `await`/`yield` in the outer function body raised `AwaitExpressionFormalParameter`/`YieldInParameter`.

The fix moves `this.expressionScope.exit()` out of the `else` branch to the end of `parseFunctionBody`, matching the upstream resolution (babel PR #13928). I rebuilt `packages/babel-parser/lib/index.js` (tests import `../lib`) and verified:

- Both issue cases now parse: `(async function () { function f(_=()=>null) {} await null; })` and the `yield` variant
- The FAIL_TO_PASS fixtures pass: `es2017/async functions/await following arrow inside params` and `es2015/yield/yield following arrow in params`
- Full `packages/babel-parser` suite: 10737 passed (the 4 `babel-core` failures are pre-existing environment issues, confirmed identical without the fix)
